# Cressida Lindsay

## Overview

- **Age:** Eighteen during her Freshman year at Wexcombe  <sub>[v3 c4 P44](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c4 P0](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0000)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Wexcombe College  <sub>[v3 c4 P45](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0045)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mrs. Ezra Hale  <sub>[v3 c31 P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v4 c27 P8](../source/v04-c27.md#nw-v04-c27-p0008)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Cressy  <sub>[v3 c4 P24](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Cressida possesses an irregular, captivating beauty, with shiny nut-brown hair, dark and plush eyes under angled black eyebrows, a warm complexion, and a soft, uneven mouth with white teeth. She is an exceptionally stylish dresser with dimples in her cheeks, and she notices herself growing slightly riper in figure as she matures.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020), [v3 c4 P39](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0039), [v3 c4 P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056), [v3 c31 P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 c33 P13](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0013)_

## Personality

Cressida is cheerful, lively, and candid, with an affectionate and generous nature. She suffers from chronic indecisiveness, finding it difficult to choose between choices or make up her mind on her own. Although she presents a lighthearted, frivolous, and vain exterior, she possesses a warm, faithful, and sweet soul underneath.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P25](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0025), [v3 c4 P36](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0036), [v3 c4 P41](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0041), [v3 c27 P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)_

- Indecisive  <sub>[v3 c4 P25](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0025)</sub>

## Abilities

- Talented at mathematics  <sub>[v3 c26 P9](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0009), [v3 c37 P3](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0003)</sub>
- Skilled at styling hair and tying bows  <sub>[v1 c19 P34](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0034)</sub>

## Goals

- To enjoy life, charm others, and have fun before settling down  <sub>[v3 c4 P48](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0048), [v3 c20 P7](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0007)</sub>
- To win the Johnson Scholarship in Mathematics  <sub>[v3 c26 P9](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0009)</sub>

## History

Cressida attended Wexcombe College, where she quickly formed a close friendship with Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis. During her Freshman year, she lived in a boardinghouse on Wallace Street before joining Nell, Honora, and Mabel Colby in renting Tabby's Place for their remaining years at college. Though pursued by numerous suitors, including two prominent ones named Hector and Orlando, she fell in love with Ezra Hale, an earnest theology student. They eventually became engaged during their Junior year. After graduating from Wexcombe with Honors in Mathematics, Cressida married Ezra at Mount Holly the following June, subsequently moving with him to serve a mission church on Tanner Street.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P24](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0024), [v3 c4 P44](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0044), [v3 c4 P50](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0050), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c27 P17](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0017), [v3 c37 P3](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0003), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

- Raised in a wealthy family at Mount Holly in Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c15 P36](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0036), [v4 c21 P0](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0000)</sub>

## Quotes

> I am incapable of deciding things for myself—my indecisiveness is a constant trial to me.  <sub>[v3 c4 P25](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0025)</sub>

> It is far better to share a simple meal of herbs alongside your friends than to eat a fattened ox in an isolated boardinghouse.  <sub>[v3 c10 P53](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0053)</sub>

> People like myself are needed in the world, Nell, if only to entertain it.  <sub>[v3 c20 P7](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0007)</sub>

> I am not truly frivolous at my core. But I have a kind of frivolous outer layer that I am unable to shed.  <sub>[v3 c27 P20](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0020)</sub>
